items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: He was a visitor. He had no right to stop anything, but we were all friends. It was all right.

ctx.x: Was he there as sort of a consultant to Norman?
He was a visitor. He had no right to stop anything, but we were all friends. It was all right.
Norman was willing to pay the extra money for the extra time Barry was costing him.
